source: 2026 NGC Annual Conference Session Handbook + Agenda Update (page 12)

data.title: 160th Session of the North Georgia Annual Conference

items.title: Clergy Executive Session
items.note: The clergy members meet on their own to vote on matters of ordination, character, and conference relationship. Closed to non-clergy.
items.noteEs: Los miembros del clero se reúnen aparte para votar sobre ordenación, conducta y relación con la conferencia. Cerrada a no clérigos.

items.title: Youth Members / Offering Assignments — Grand Hall 1
Lay Candidate Forum — Grand Hall
items.note: Lay people standing for election as delegates introduce themselves and answer questions before voting begins.
items.noteEs: Los laicos candidatos a delegados se presentan y responden preguntas antes de que comience la votación.

items.title: Session One — Opening Worship (Preacher: Bishop Robin Dease)
Call to Order — 160th Session
items.note: The presiding bishop formally opens the session — the business meeting of the whole conference, clergy and laity together.
items.noteEs: El obispo que preside abre formalmente la sesión — la reunión de asuntos de toda la conferencia, clero y laicos juntos.

items.title: Organization of Conference
items.note: The opening business that formally constitutes the conference: setting the bar of the house, adopting the agenda, and seating its members.
items.noteEs: Los asuntos iniciales que constituyen formalmente la conferencia: fijar el recinto, adoptar la agenda y dar asiento a sus miembros.

items.title: Board of Ordained Ministry: Presentation of Candidates
Historic Examination for Admission into Full Connection
items.note: The bishop puts Wesley's historic questions (“Have you faith in Christ? Are you going on to perfection?…”) to those being admitted as full clergy members — a tradition dating to the earliest Methodist conferences.
items.noteEs: El obispo plantea las preguntas históricas de Wesley (“¿Tienes fe en Cristo? ¿Vas en camino a la perfección?…”) a quienes son admitidos como miembros clérigos plenos — una tradición que data de las primeras conferencias metodistas.

items.title: Session Two — Call to Order
items.note: The bishop reconvenes the conference for the next block of business.
items.noteEs: El obispo reanuda la conferencia para el siguiente bloque de asuntos.

items.title: Common Table Report: One Georgia Task Force
Session Three — Service of Licensure, Commissioning, and Ordination (Preacher: Bishop Héctor A. Burgos-Núñez)
items.note: The service in which the bishop licenses local pastors, commissions candidates as provisional members, and ordains deacons and elders, laying hands on those entering ministry.
items.noteEs: El culto en que el obispo otorga licencia a pastores locales, comisiona a candidatos como miembros provisionales y ordena diáconos y presbíteros, imponiendo las manos sobre quienes entran al ministerio.

items.title: Service of Holy Communion — Grand Hall 2-3
items.note: An early-morning communion service open to all before the day's business begins.
items.noteEs: Un culto de comunión a primera hora, abierto a todos antes de que comiencen los asuntos del día.

items.title: Session Four — Call to Order & Morning Devotion
items.note: The bishop reconvenes the conference and the day's business opens with a brief devotion.
items.noteEs: El obispo reanuda la conferencia y los asuntos del día comienzan con una breve devoción.

items.title: Blessing of Mari Ellyzsa Valencia (Global Ministries)
items.note: The conference prays over and sends a missionary serving through the General Board of Global Ministries.
items.noteEs: La conferencia ora por una misionera y la envía a servir a través de la Junta General de Ministerios Globales.

items.title: Consent Agenda — remove any requested items
Recognition of Retirees
items.note: The conference honors the clergy retiring this year, marking their years of service and the close of their active appointments.
items.noteEs: La conferencia honra al clero que se jubila este año, reconociendo sus años de servicio y el fin de sus nombramientos activos.

items.title: Session Five — Service of Remembrance (Preacher: Vance Ross) & Conference Special Offering
items.note: A worship service honoring the clergy and lay members who have died since the last annual conference, with a special offering received.
items.noteEs: Un culto que honra a los miembros clérigos y laicos que han fallecido desde la última conferencia anual, con una ofrenda especial.

items.title: Call to Order of Business Session
items.note: The bishop reconvenes the conference for the next block of business.
items.noteEs: El obispo reanuda la conferencia para el siguiente bloque de asuntos.

items.title: Conference Safe Sanctuary Policy
items.note: The conference's policy for protecting children, youth, and vulnerable adults from abuse in ministry settings.
items.noteEs: La política de la conferencia para proteger de abuso a niños, jóvenes y adultos vulnerables en los entornos ministeriales.

items.title: Laity Address
items.note: The Conference Lay Leader addresses the body on behalf of the laity — the church members who are not clergy.
items.noteEs: El Líder Laico de la Conferencia se dirige al cuerpo en nombre de los laicos — los miembros de la iglesia que no son clérigos.

items.title: Session Six — Voting Session (subject to cancellation if voting has concluded)
Service of Holy Communion — Grand Hall 2-3
items.note: An early-morning communion service open to all before the day's business begins.
items.noteEs: Un culto de comunión a primera hora, abierto a todos antes de que comiencen los asuntos del día.

items.title: Session Seven — Call to Order & Morning Devotion (Bishop Dease)
items.note: The bishop reconvenes the conference for its final day, opening with a brief devotion.
items.noteEs: El obispo reanuda la conferencia para su último día, comenzando con una breve devoción.

items.title: North Georgia Camping and Retreat Ministries
Committee on the Status and Role of Women
Faith Connection Federal Credit Union Scholarship
UM Commission on Higher Education — Francis Asbury Award
Future Dates & Sites of Annual Conference
Service of Word and Table & Fixing of Appointments (Preacher: Max Vincent)
items.note: Closing worship with Holy Communion (“Word and Table”) in which the bishop formally fixes the clergy appointments — who will serve which church — for the coming year.
items.noteEs: Culto de clausura con la Santa Comunión (“Palabra y Mesa”) en el que el obispo fija formalmente los nombramientos del clero — quién servirá en cada iglesia — para el próximo año.

items.title: Adjournment of the 160th Session
items.note: The bishop declares the annual conference closed until it gathers again next year.
items.noteEs: El obispo declara cerrada la conferencia anual hasta que vuelva a reunirse el próximo año.
